paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between experimental length and attention weights. The horizontal axis represents experimental length, with categories labeled at intervals of 5, ranging from 5 to 35, and no specified scale type or order. The vertical axis, labeled "Attention Weights," has a scale ranging from 0.20 to 0.45, with a linear progression and tick labels at regular intervals of 0.05. The chart features six blue bars, each corresponding to a specific experimental length: the bar for experimental length 10 has an approximate value of 0.42, while the bars for lengths 15 and 5 have approximate values of 0.42 and 0.39, respectively; the bar for length 20 has an approximate value of 0.36, and the bars for lengths 30 and 25 have approximate values of 0.35 and 0.32, respectively. There is no apparent sorting or visual emphasis of the bars.
